prompt: Work autonomously and do not ask questions. Implement `min_coins(coins, amount)` in src/lib.rs. Return the minimum number of coins whose values sum exactly to `amount`, or `None` when it is impossible. `amount == 0` needs zero coins. A coin value of 0 makes the input invalid and returns `None`. Keep the public API and the existing tests unchanged. Run `cargo test` and finish only when the tests pass.
